description: Read a stored page report by report ID: the scores and the prioritized fix checklist, with a note on any fixes locked on the account's plan. Use it when you already have a report ID (from analyze_website, check_status or list_reports). It reads saved data and never rescans, so it shows the page as it was when scanned; call analyze_website to see changes. Returns an error if the ID is unknown or belongs to another account. Free: does not use a credit.

report_id.description: Report ID (UUID) from analyze_website, check_status or list_reports, for example 3f2b8c1e-9a4d-4b7e-8c21-5d6e7f8a9b0c

name: get_report
title: Read a page report
